title: Shanghai's Free Water Town Is One Metro Ride Away (Line 17) | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone books a tour to Shanghai's water towns. Locals just ride the metro to Zhujiajiao — and walking in is free.

Zhujiajiao is a Ming-era canal town in Shanghai's Qingpu District, reachable on Metro Line 17 (get off at Zhujiajiao Station, Exit 1). The old town streets are free to wander; only a handful of interior sights charge. The ¥60 combo ticket covers just three attractions — Kezhi Garden, Hexin Garden and the Shanghai Helong Art Museum — so skip it unless those are your thing. Canals, stone bridges, and an optional boat ride are the real draw.

🧭 Expert Tip: Go on a weekday morning. Zhujiajiao is packed on weekends, and the light on the canals is best early. Confirm the current combo price on the official booking page before you go.
